zoom.description: Zoom level, from 0 (the world) to 19 (a building)

markers.description: A ./file (GeoJSON, CSV) or https:// URL, or a list of { lat, lng }

regions.description: A ./file.geojson or https:// URL of regions to draw

label.description: The property or column that names each marker or region

size.description: The numeric property or column that sizes each marker

value.description: The numeric property that colours each region

labels.description: Show the labels on the map

tiles.description: Street map: a provider (osm, …), a URL template with {z}, {x} and {y}, or none

attribution.description: The tile provider's credit, shown on the map

roam.description: Let the audience pan and zoom

thousands.description: How this map's data groups thousands, when not plainly. Default: the deck's

delimiter.description: What separates a CSV's cells, when the header doesn't make it clear
